meta.prompt_source: 用户提供的图表作文题面（英语二 Part B，来源年份不详）

band.rationale: 对照第 2 节档位描述：本文'未能按照要求完成试题规定的任务'——仅 83 词（约为建议下限 150 词的 55%，脚本 length_status=short_two_thirds），图表描述与评论均单句带过、无任何展开；'语法结构单调、词汇项目有限'——通篇为简单句，词汇围绕 volunteer/join 高度重复；'有较多语法结构或词汇方面的错误'——students is、volunteer have、one or two time、In conclude、let students to do 等基础错误遍布每段，密度远超第三档'有一些错误，但不影响理解'的描述，但尚可读懂，未到第一档'有碍理解'。同时触发第 4.3 条字数硬规则（低于下限的 2/3：任务完成维度减半、封顶第三档）。综合定第二档居中偏上。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35% students never join, most students only join one or two time. Few students join many times.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 未偏题，图表三类数据（35% 从未、多数 1-2 次、少数 3 次及以上）均被覆盖且数字正确，原始可给 3/5；但触发第 4.3 条硬规则：83 词低于建议下限 150 词的 2/3（ratio_to_minimum=0.553），任务完成维度分减半 3→1.5。另未点明'每月''某高校'等图表要素，描述极简。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: I think one reason is students is busy with their homework, another reason is volunteer is boring.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 原因、益处、建议各仅一句话，无例证、无深入分析，评论停留在最表层，远未达到任务要求的展开程度。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: Why this happen? ... In conclude, volunteer have many advantage.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三段式（描述—归因—结论）结构清楚，用了 one reason...another reason 的简单衔接，但过渡手段贫乏，存在 comma splice，且结论标记语误写为 In conclude。

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: one reason is students is busy with their homework, another reason is volunteer is boring.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 主谓一致（students is、volunteer have）、名词复数（one or two time、many advantage）、助动词缺失（Why this happen）、let students to do 等基础错误几乎每句都有；句式全部为简单句，无任何从句或变化。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: It can make us happy and learn knowledge.
dimensions.deduction_reason: learn knowledge 为中式直译；join 反复误配（缺宾语）、volunteer 误作抽象活动名词、University/Student 缺冠词与复数，用词量小且重复。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: Nowadays, volunteer is very popular in university.

consistency.adjustments: 初评切题与图表解读 3/5；因 83/150=0.553（低于下限的 2/3，高于 1/2），按第 4.3 条将该维度减半为 1.5 并将档位封顶第三档。各维度合计 1.5+1+1+0.5+0.5+1=5.5，落在第二档 4-6 区间内，且错误密度证据不支持第三档，校验通过。

sentence_edits.original: Nowadays, volunteer is very popular in university.
sentence_edits.issue: volunteer 是可数名词'志愿者'，表示'志愿服务'这一活动应用 volunteering。
sentence_edits.revised: Nowadays, volunteering is very popular among university students.

sentence_edits.original: From the chart, we can see some students do not like volunteer.
sentence_edits.issue: like 后接活动应用动名词，like volunteer 缺少名词形式；建议补 that 引导宾语从句更规范。
sentence_edits.revised: From the chart, we can see that some students do not like volunteering.

sentence_edits.original: 35% students never join, most students only join one or two time.
sentence_edits.issue: 百分数后应加 of，即 35% of the students；join 缺宾语且搭配不当；one or two time 应为 times；逗号连接两个独立句是 comma splice。
sentence_edits.revised: 35% of the students never participate in it, and most of them do so only once or twice.

sentence_edits.issue: join many times 搭配生硬且不精确，图表原意是'3 次及以上'，用 three times or more 更贴切。
sentence_edits.revised: Only a few students take part three times or more.

sentence_edits.issue: 疑问句缺少助动词，且主谓不一致。

sentence_edits.original: I think one reason is students is busy with their homework, another reason is volunteer is boring.
sentence_edits.issue: students is 主谓一致错误；another reason 前应用 and 连接（当前为 comma splice）；volunteer 应用 volunteering；reason is 后建议加 that 引导从句。
sentence_edits.revised: I think one reason is that students are busy with their homework, and another reason is that volunteering is boring.

sentence_edits.original: In conclude, volunteer have many advantage.
sentence_edits.issue: 结论标记语应为 In conclusion；volunteer have 应为 volunteering has（主谓一致与名词形式）；many advantage 应为复数 advantages。
sentence_edits.revised: In conclusion, volunteering has many advantages.

sentence_edits.original: It can make us happy and learn knowledge.
sentence_edits.issue: learn knowledge 是'学习知识'的直译，搭配不成立，应为 gain/get knowledge；且 make us happy and learn 结构不平行，learn 的逻辑主语缺失。
sentence_edits.revised: It can make us happy and help us gain knowledge.

sentence_edits.original: University should let students to do more volunteer.
sentence_edits.issue: 泛指高校应用复数 Universities；let sb do 不带 to，此处用 encourage sb to do 更贴切；more volunteer 后缺名词 work。
sentence_edits.revised: Universities should encourage students to do more volunteer work.

sentence_edits.issue: 泛指学生应用复数 Students；also 位置应在 should 之后；do it 指代模糊。
sentence_edits.revised: Students should also take an active part in it.

improved_version:
The chart above illustrates how often students at a certain university take part in volunteer activities each month. According to the chart, 35% of the students never participate in volunteering, while 45% do so only once or twice. Merely 20% volunteer three times or more.

Why do so few students volunteer regularly? In my view, two reasons account for this phenomenon. For one thing, students are under heavy pressure from their studies and can hardly spare any time. For another, some volunteer activities are poorly organized, so students find them boring.

In conclusion, volunteering benefits both students and society. It not only brings us happiness and a sense of achievement but also helps us gain practical knowledge. Therefore, universities should organize more attractive volunteer programs, and students should also take an active part in them.
top_problems: 字数严重不足：全文仅 83 词，约为建议下限 150 词的 55%（脚本 length_status=short_two_thirds），描述与评论都只有单句罗列、毫无展开，直接触发'低于 2/3 则任务完成维度减半并封顶第三档'的硬规则，是最大的失分源。
基础语法错误遍布全文：主谓一致（students is、volunteer have）、名词单复数（one or two time、many advantage）、助动词缺失（Why this happen）、let students to do 等几乎每句都有，符合第二档'有较多语法结构或词汇方面的错误'的描述。
词汇量小且中式直译明显：learn knowledge、join（缺宾语反复出现）、In conclude、volunteer 误作活动名词，全文翻来覆去只用 volunteer/join/students 几个词，缺乏基本的话题搭配储备。
practice_advice: 每周用'图表描述（含三类数据+总体概括）→ 两个原因 → 结论与建议'的三段框架写一篇 140-150 词的图表作文，写完后只做三项自查：每个谓语动词和主语的单复数是否一致、可数名词是否需要复数或冠词、like/let/help 等动词后面该接什么形式；把每次查出的错误记进一张个人错题表，四周后主谓一致与名词单复数类错误基本可以清零。

patterns: The chart illustrates how often ... take part in ...
According to the chart, X% of the students ..., while Y% ...
Two reasons account for this. For one thing, ... For another, ...
